records.Concise description: Shroomtoshi’s pioneering Bitcoin-native pixel-art collection, recognized for very early inscriptions and strong use of Bitcoin cultural references.
records.Deeper researched summary: Bitcoin Shrooms is a hand-authored collection by the pseudonymous artist Shroomtoshi and became one of the earliest recognizable Ordinals art bodies. Sotheby’s dedicated December 2023 auction helped move Ordinals into the traditional fine-art auction context. Shroomtoshi later inscribed a final message stating that there were no official affiliated social accounts or projects and that they had moved on to other things. MSC therefore treats the original project as INACTIVE even though the inscriptions remain collectible and secondary-market activity continues.
records.Launch / history: Inscribed beginning in early 2023; a dedicated Sotheby’s sale in December 2023 became a major institutional milestone for Ordinals art.
records.Why it matters in the Ordinals ecosystem: Its unusually early provenance, Bitcoin-native iconography, and Sotheby’s recognition make it a foundational cultural/art-history reference.
records.Verification basis: First-party Bitcoin Shrooms provenance/disclaimer material, Shroomtoshi’s on-chain final message, and Sotheby’s primary auction catalog.
Research notes / uncertainties: Public/indexed supply figures vary by source and collection treatment; do not publish a fixed total unless Command Center later defines a canonical counting rule.
Creator/project operation is inactive; secondary-market trading and collector activity do not change the project lifecycle status.

records.Concise description: A prominent Ordinals portrait collection created by ZK Shark with art by Tony Tafuro, known for inscription provenance, sat hunting, and high-profile auction-house exposure.
records.Deeper researched summary: Ordinal Maxi Biz blends expressive portrait art with deliberate inscription and sat-provenance choices. Christie’s documented a 5,141-work OMB collection in April 2024 and identified creator ZK Shark, lead artist Tony Tafuro, artist berkin bags, and developer/rare-sat contributor Nullish. Later/current Ordinals indexes expose a broader OMB universe approaching 9,000 works. Those figures are best treated as dated/scope-specific snapshots rather than a single timeless supply claim. OMB remains culturally active, but MSC should not collapse historical auction scope and current indexed scope into one unqualified number.
records.Launch / history: The project expanded through 2023–2024; Christie’s hosted an OMB sale in April 2024, its first Bitcoin Ordinals sale on christies.com.
records.Why it matters in the Ordinals ecosystem: OMB connected Ordinals collector culture, rare-sat provenance, and established auction infrastructure, becoming one of the ecosystem’s best-known PFP/art brands.

records.Verification basis: Christie’s primary 2024 creator/history documentation plus current Ordinals index/market visibility and continuing OMB ecosystem activity.
Research notes / uncertainties: Christie’s 5,141 count is a dated April 2024 collection scope; later/current indexes expose roughly 9,000 OMB works. Do not publish one timeless supply number unless a current first-party canonical scope is defined.
Creator and contributor attribution is sufficiently supported by Christie’s primary sale documentation.

records.Concise description: A 10,001-piece free-mint Ordinals collection by Le Puppeteer Fou whose deliberately absurd puppet aesthetic developed into a large community-driven culture.
records.Deeper researched summary: Bitcoin Puppets launched as a free mint in January 2024 after the smaller O.P.I.U.M. precursor. The current community hub explicitly frames the project around community, permissive visual use, and lack of a traditional roadmap. The pseudonymous creator deleted project socials in late 2025, but community infrastructure and related culture remain active, so status is ACTIVE with a community-led qualifier.
records.Launch / history: O.P.I.U.M. precursor: 777-piece free mint in March 2023. Bitcoin Puppets: 10,001-piece free mint January 3–4, 2024.
records.Why it matters in the Ordinals ecosystem: Puppets became a defining example of Ordinals meme/PFP culture and community-led continuity after the original creator receded.
records.Verification basis: Current first-party/community-controlled hub and related PUPS first-party history.
Research notes / uncertainties: Creator deletion of socials in December 2025 does not mean the collector community is inactive.
PUPS later migrated to Runes and belongs canonically in RUNES; link it here rather than duplicating a token profile.

records.Concise description: A 777-piece 2023 free-mint precursor created by Le Puppeteer Fou before Bitcoin Puppets.
records.Deeper researched summary: O.P.I.U.M. predates Bitcoin Puppets and is explicitly presented by the Puppets community as part of the same creator lineage. It is historically important for understanding the visual and community roots that later expanded into the much larger Puppets ecosystem. The original mint is complete; current relevance is mainly historical and relational.
records.Launch / history: Free mint on March 25, 2023; 777 pieces. Bitcoin Puppets followed in January 2024.
records.Why it matters in the Ordinals ecosystem: It provides the direct on-chain/cultural precursor to one of Ordinals’ most recognizable later communities.
records.Verification basis: Current Bitcoin Puppets community history page.
Research notes / uncertainties: Treat as its own historical entity because it has distinct inscriptions and launch history, while linking tightly to Bitcoin Puppets.
